extra.reason:
Shipped in PR #7 (merge 144eced), master CI green on 5 platforms + ASan/TSan.

1) Added ui.layout (auto|split|tabs) to the C++ Config and to sstvae/gui/settings.py, so the two apps still agree about config.json; View > Layout picks it and an explicit pick ends 'auto'.
2) gui/pane_container.cpp owns the switch. Build the new container FIRST (which reparents both panels out of the old one), then delete the old -- detaching via setParent(nullptr) marks panels explicitly hidden and they never come back. Every addWidget/addTab hides what it reparents, so the new container needs an explicit show(); and a QTabWidget's background page is *explicitly* hidden, so rebuilding the splitter must show both panes by hand. Both caught by test_pane_container.cpp on its first run, not by reading.
3) Measured, real panels, sstvae-gui-shot --panes: 1043 px side by side vs 545 px tabbed.
4) 'auto' resolves ONCE at startup against the SCREEN, never the window -- while side-by-side is in force the splitter's minimum is exactly what stops the window reaching the width that would trigger a switch away from it, so a live breakpoint's downward transition is unreachable by construction.
5) Receive status line mirrored into the status bar while tabbed, since tabs give back the one thing side-by-side buys.
6) FOUND AND FIXED A SHIPPED DEFECT: setFixedHeight(width*3/4) as an aspect pin is a ratchet (fixed height = hard minimum). Replaced with geometry in the new gui/picture_box.cpp, and the identical line in OverlayEditor was worse -- transmit panel min height ran 611/925/1274 px at 545/1348/1900 wide, so tabs would have traded 498 px of width for hundreds of px of height on exactly the screens auto selects. Now flat at 611.
7) Review at creation: 5 findings, all accepted, remediated in its own commit afa7e82 and posted to the PR. Included a teardown UAF this change created (~ReceivePanel -> stop() -> emits -> slot reads a destructed QString in the half-destroyed PaneContainer, every quit), the status mirror dropping updates behind QStatusBar::showMessage, an untested config read path, and three tautological assertions in my own test.
8) Both ratchet copies are mutation-tested; sstvae-gui-shot --panes now reports BOTH axes, since a width-only number measures the axis this layout improves and is silent on the one it can wreck -- which is why finding 1 was missed here.

Supersedes SSTVAE-rv9 (scroll areas treat the symptom; the floor is a property of the arrangement).

Superseded by SSTVAE-wub (merged, PR #7). This proposed QScrollArea treatment for the panes; that treats the symptom. The floor is a property of the ARRANGEMENT -- a QSplitter's minimum width is the sum of its children's, a QTabWidget's is the max -- so no amount of scrolling inside the panes moves it. Measured on the real panels: 1043 px side by side vs 545 px tabbed, which is the whole 498 px this issue was asking for. wub also removed the setFixedHeight ratchet in both the receive preview and the overlay editor, which was pinning the window's minimum HEIGHT to pane width (611/925/1274 px at 545/1348/1900) -- the same class of problem on the other axis, and not something a scroll area would have touched.
